Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 after model deploy - immediate help needed

I'm seeing repeated kernel fallbacks on decode for v3.4.1 with quant profile QP-9 — host logs show several GLIBC_SYMBOL errors and the runtime is switching to fallback kernels that are ~3-4x slower. That explains p95 jump and the subsequent 429s from the gateway as the system hits concurrent token limits.

Quick mitigation options (ranked):
- Route RetailGo traffic to v3.3.8 (no quant) immediately. Fast, low risk.
- Temporarily disable QP-9 for v3.4.1 for RetailGo only (config change) — medium risk, might still have slow paths.
- Full rollback of v3.4.1 — highest blast radius to other customers during global rollback, but safest if systemic.

I recommend routing to v3.3.8 for RetailGo and keeping v3.4.1 live for others while we debug kernel mismatch. Setting up the policy now.

Hannah
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
